text.tspan: Measured two-hub Azure Virtual WAN lab
6 VNets | 10 Ubuntu VMs | 2 secured hubs during intent tests | 2 x 50 Mbps ExpressRoute circuits
Auxiliary Azure gateways and separately controlled SE MCR inputs are distinct evidence sources.
NE customer BGP, integrated SD-WAN, ECMP/ties and broad forced tunneling were not certified.
